Sun-Sun.explanation: Sun-Sun aspects reflect core identity and ego. Compatibility depends on mutual respect and shared values.
Sun-Sun.romanticMeaning: Can create a strong sense of partnership, but may lead to ego clashes if not balanced.
Sun-Sun.friendshipMeaning: Encourages mutual support and leadership, but competition can arise.
Sun-Sun.workMeaning: Works well if both respect each other's authority; potential for power struggles.
Sun-Sun.evals: Balanced leadership, moderate synergy, possible rivalry.

Sun-Moon.explanation: Sun-Moon aspects blend conscious will with emotional needs, fostering understanding and harmony.
Sun-Moon.romanticMeaning: Creates emotional security and deep attraction; one partner supports the other's goals.
Sun-Moon.friendshipMeaning: Promotes empathy and loyalty; friends feel comfortable sharing personal matters.
Sun-Moon.workMeaning: Excellent for teamwork; one leads, the other supports, creating balance.
Sun-Moon.evals: Strong emotional support, high synergy, nurturing dynamic.

Moon-Moon.explanation: Moon-Moon aspects indicate emotional resonance and shared instincts.
Moon-Moon.romanticMeaning: Deep emotional connection and mutual understanding; nurturing relationship.
Moon-Moon.friendshipMeaning: Friends feel safe and understood; strong emotional bond.
Moon-Moon.workMeaning: Collaboration flows easily; both are sensitive to each other's needs.
Moon-Moon.evals: Excellent emotional rapport, intuitive understanding, harmonious teamwork.

Moon-Venus.explanation: Moon-Venus aspects enhance affection, comfort, and appreciation of beauty.
Moon-Venus.romanticMeaning: Romantic attraction is strong; partners feel cherished and emotionally fulfilled.
Moon-Venus.friendshipMeaning: Creates warmth and kindness; friends enjoy pleasant times together.
Moon-Venus.workMeaning: Cooperation is smooth; both value harmony and aesthetics in their work.
Moon-Venus.evals: Affectionate bond, creative partnership, emotional comfort.

Venus-Mars.explanation: Venus-Mars aspects combine desire and action, fueling attraction and creative energy.
Venus-Mars.romanticMeaning: Passionate and dynamic relationship; can be exciting but sometimes volatile.
Venus-Mars.friendshipMeaning: Encourages fun and adventure; may lead to competitiveness.
Venus-Mars.workMeaning: Good for creative projects; energy and ideas flow, but may clash over direction.
Venus-Mars.evals: Energetic chemistry, creative tension, potential volatility.

Venus-Venus.explanation: Venus-Venus aspects reflect shared values, tastes, and approach to relationships.
Venus-Venus.romanticMeaning: Partners enjoy similar pleasures and romantic styles; harmony is easy.
Venus-Venus.friendshipMeaning: Friends appreciate each other's company and share interests.
Venus-Venus.workMeaning: Collaboration is pleasant; both value fairness and beauty in their work.
Venus-Venus.evals: Shared values, harmonious relationships, easy collaboration.

Mars-Mars.explanation: Mars-Mars aspects highlight drive, ambition, and conflict resolution styles.
Mars-Mars.romanticMeaning: Can lead to arguments and power struggles; passion may turn to conflict.
Mars-Mars.friendshipMeaning: Competitive energy; friends may push each other, sometimes too hard.
Mars-Mars.workMeaning: Potential for clashes; both want to lead and may struggle to cooperate.
Mars-Mars.evals: High tension, competitive drive, frequent conflict.

Mercury-Mercury.explanation: Mercury-Mercury aspects indicate intellectual rapport and communication ease.
Mercury-Mercury.romanticMeaning: Partners understand each other well; conversations are stimulating.
Mercury-Mercury.friendshipMeaning: Great for sharing ideas and learning together; few misunderstandings.
Mercury-Mercury.workMeaning: Excellent for teamwork; communication is clear and effective.
Mercury-Mercury.evals: Clear communication, intellectual synergy, productive teamwork.

Mercury-Venus.explanation: Mercury-Venus aspects blend intellect with affection, supporting pleasant exchanges.
Mercury-Venus.romanticMeaning: Flirtation and sweet talk; partners express love easily.
Mercury-Venus.workMeaning: Good for creative collaboration; ideas are shared with kindness.
Mercury-Venus.evals: Pleasant exchanges, creative communication, moderate synergy.

Sun-Venus.explanation: Sun-Venus aspects foster attraction, admiration, and mutual appreciation.
Sun-Venus.romanticMeaning: Strong romantic chemistry; partners admire and support each other.
Sun-Venus.friendshipMeaning: Easy friendship; both enjoy spending time together.
Sun-Venus.workMeaning: Collaboration is harmonious; both value positive relationships.
Sun-Venus.evals: Mutual admiration, positive chemistry, harmonious teamwork.

Moon-Mars.explanation: Moon-Mars aspects combine emotion and action, creating dynamic interactions.
Moon-Mars.romanticMeaning: Attraction is intense; can be passionate but sometimes turbulent.
Moon-Mars.friendshipMeaning: Encourages motivation and activity; may lead to emotional disagreements.
Moon-Mars.workMeaning: Good for energetic teamwork; may need to manage emotional reactions.
Moon-Mars.evals: Dynamic energy, emotional motivation, occasional turbulence.
